parts.t: MacKenzie Heights is one of Vancouver's most exclusive residential enclaves, perched on a gentle rise between Dunbar and Kerrisdale. With premium homes, sought-after school catchments, and a refined neighbourhood character, it's a top choice for families seeking the best of Vancouver's West Side.
